Name: rpi4_mount_pitch_x
Comment: Raspberry Pi 4 / Pi 5 mounting hole pitch — X axis (long side).

Name: rpi4_mount_pitch_y
Comment: Raspberry Pi 4 / Pi 5 mounting hole pitch — Y axis.

Name: rpi_board_width
Comment: Raspberry Pi PCB width.

Name: rpi_board_length
Comment: Raspberry Pi PCB length.

Name: octopus_mount_pitch_x
Comment: BTT Octopus / Octopus Pro board mounting hole pitch — X.

Name: octopus_mount_pitch_y
Comment: BTT Octopus board mounting hole pitch — Y.

Name: skr_mini_mount_pitch_x
Comment: BTT SKR Mini E3 V3 mounting hole pitch — X. BabyBelt Pro mainboard.

Name: skr_mini_mount_pitch_y
Comment: BTT SKR Mini E3 V3 mounting hole pitch — Y.

Name: pcb_edge_clearance
Comment: Minimum clearance from PCB edge to enclosure wall — allows for component overhang and manufacturing tolerance.

Name: din_rail_width
Comment: TS35 top-hat DIN rail width (EN 60715; supersedes withdrawn EN 50022). Used for clip geometry in electrical panel and control box designs.

Name: din_rail_clip_depth
Comment: Typical DIN rail clip engagement depth for reliable snap-on retention.

Name: jst_xh_2pin_width
Comment: JST-XH 2-pin connector body width. 2.54 mm pitch. Used for cutout and slot sizing in terminal blocks.

Name: jst_xh_height
Comment: JST-XH connector body height.

Name: usb_a_panel_width
Comment: Standard USB-A panel cutout width.

Name: usb_a_panel_height
Comment: Standard USB-A panel cutout height.

Name: usb_c_panel_width
Comment: Standard USB-C panel cutout width.

Name: usb_c_panel_height
Comment: Standard USB-C panel cutout height.

Name: xt30_panel_dia
Comment: XT30 connector panel cutout hole diameter. Used on 48V toolhead and Doomcube power distribution.

Name: xt60_panel_dia
Comment: XT60 connector panel cutout hole diameter.

Name: wago221_body_width_2way
Comment: WAGO 221-412 (2-conductor) lever nut body width. For printed mounting clips and wire management blocks.

Name: wago221_body_height
Comment: WAGO 221 lever nut body height.

Name: wago221_body_depth
Comment: WAGO 221 lever nut body depth.

Name: esp32_board_width
Comment: ESP32 DevKit V1 PCB width. Common ESPHome BLE proxy board.

Name: esp32_board_length
Comment: ESP32 DevKit V1 PCB length.

Name: d1mini_board_width
Comment: Wemos D1 Mini board width.

Name: d1mini_board_length
Comment: Wemos D1 Mini board length.

Name: gang_box_internal_width
Comment: Standard US single-gang electrical box internal width. Used for custom insert and bracket designs.

Name: gang_box_internal_height
Comment: Standard US single-gang electrical box internal height.

Name: decora_cutout_width
Comment: Decora / paddle-style faceplate cutout width. For custom switch plates and smart home inserts.

Name: decora_cutout_height
Comment: Decora faceplate cutout height.

Name: conduit_half_inch_knockout_dia
Comment: ½ inch conduit knockout diameter in standard US electrical boxes.

Name: conduit_three_quarter_inch_knockout_dia
Comment: ¾ inch conduit knockout diameter.

Name: sonoff_zbdongle_p_width
Comment: Sonoff Zigbee Dongle Plus body width — for printed mount and bracket design.

Name: sonoff_zbdongle_p_length
Comment: Sonoff Zigbee Dongle Plus body length.

Name: rpi_mount_hole_dia
Comment: Raspberry Pi 4/5 mounting hole diameter; M2.5 screws, 3.5 mm in from edges. Source: RPi mechanical spec

Name: rpi_pico_board_length
Comment: Raspberry Pi Pico board length. Source: RPi Pico datasheet

Name: rpi_pico_board_width
Comment: Raspberry Pi Pico board width.

Name: rpi_pico_mount_pitch_x
Comment: Pico mounting hole pitch (long axis).

Name: rpi_pico_mount_pitch_y
Comment: Pico mounting hole pitch (short axis).

Name: rpi_pico_mount_hole_dia
Comment: Pico mounting hole diameter.

Name: rpi_zero_board_length
Comment: Raspberry Pi Zero / Zero 2 W board length. Source: RPi mechanical spec

Name: rpi_zero_board_width
Comment: Raspberry Pi Zero board width.

Name: rpi_zero_mount_pitch_x
Comment: Pi Zero mounting hole pitch (long axis).

Name: rpi_zero_mount_pitch_y
Comment: Pi Zero mounting hole pitch (short axis).

Name: din_rail_depth
Comment: TS35 top-hat DIN rail depth (also a 15 mm deep variant). Source: EN 60715

Name: header_pitch
Comment: Standard 0.1 in header/breadboard/protoboard pin pitch.

Name: wallplate_std_width
Comment: US standard single-gang switch/outlet cover plate width (2.75 in).

Name: wallplate_std_height
Comment: US standard cover plate height (4.50 in).

Name: wallplate_jumbo_width
Comment: US oversized/jumbo cover plate width (3.13 in).

Name: wallplate_jumbo_height
Comment: US oversized/jumbo cover plate height (4.88 in).

Name: wallplate_thickness
Comment: Cover plate thickness, nominal. Typical range 2.5-5 mm (0.10-0.20 in).

Name: wallplate_screw_pitch
Comment: Cover-plate mounting screw spacing, vertical center-to-center (2.756 in). Same for toggle and Decora/rocker plates. Screw thread = #6-32.

Name: wallplate_screw_clearance
Comment: Clearance hole for the #6-32 device screw (major dia ~3.5 mm). ~0.144 in close clearance; open to 3.8 for printed parts.

Name: wallplate_toggle_slot_width
Comment: Classic toggle-switch opening width (0.40 in).

Name: wallplate_toggle_slot_height
Comment: Classic toggle-switch opening height (1.00 in).

Name: gang_box_yoke_screw_span
Comment: Single-gang device yoke (strap) mounting-ear screw spacing, hole-to-hole (3.28 in). This is the bracket that screws into the box; #6-32.

Name: gang_box_single_width
Comment: Single-gang box opening width, approximate (2.0 in).

Name: gang_box_single_height
Comment: Single-gang box opening height, approximate (3.0 in).

Name: gang_box_depth_min
Comment: Single-gang box depth, shallow end (2.5 in). Depth varies 2.5-3.5 in by box.

Name: gang_box_depth_max
Comment: Single-gang box depth, deep end (3.5 in).
